title: YSL Beauty steps up its investment in Brazil with first store in São Paulo
summary: Following the launch of its e-commerce platform in 2024, the French brand is expanding its presence in Brazil through targeted marketing campaigns and its first physical store, complementing its availability on TikTok Shop. Yves Saint Laurent Beauty opened its first physical store in Brazil in August.
